A large, bell-jar-shaped glass terrarium filled with green plants rests on the island. Other decorative items, including a wooden mantel clock and silver platters, are visible on the counters. A young woman wearing a dark blue shirt, jeans, and sneakers is seated on the counter next to the sink.**
